# MAVLink C headers

Generated MAVLink v2 C library, `common` dialect (which pulls in `standard` and `minimal`).

- Source: https://github.com/mavlink/c_library_v2
- Commit: 8c63a49fe35aead7f9ef14031381c5e076ff743a (2026-10-12)
- License: MIT. The MAVLink project licenses the generated C library under the MIT license
  (see https://github.com/mavlink/mavlink/blob/master/COPYING).

Only `common/`, `standard/`, `minimal/` and the top-level helper headers are vendored.
Do not edit these files; to update, copy the same folders from a newer commit and update the hash.
